raw.description: 回合开始时自身攻击、命中+1，若自身处于能力提升状态则当回合必定打出致命一击，若自身不处于能力提升状态则当回合受到的固定伤害、百分比伤害减少70%且回合结束时恢复自身最大体力的1/3|自身的打出致命一击后吸取对手最大体力的1/3，若本次攻击无效则效果翻倍且对手下1次攻击技能无效|（boss无效）
raw.desc_formatting_adjustment: 回合开始效果： 回合开始时： 自身攻击、命中+1 若自身处于能力提升状态则当回合必定打出致命一击 若自身不处于能力提升状态则当回合受到的固定伤害、百分比伤害减少70%且回合结束后恢复自身最大体力的1/3 触发效果： 自身的打出致命一击后吸取对手最大体力的1/3 若本次攻击无效则效果翻倍且对手下1次攻击技能无效

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 三条答案补齐当前自身分支：按回初强化结果必暴或减固粉70%，必暴攻击无效补偿有暴击前提；无强化回复在所有回末处理后，死亡不复活；命中零伤保持正常暴击吸取。
review.singleBehavior: 回初攻命+1，正强化快照授当回合必暴，否则固粉减70%并全部回末后回最大HP三分一；暴击后按maxHP三分一百分吸取和理论回复；有必暴资格的实际攻击MISS/失明/整招无效改为三分二并封下次攻击，没有暴击前提不独立补偿；未用不触发。

for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true,hp:1000}),c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,2024);assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.phase,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.phase,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38150?m.pp:m.pp-1);const zero=make({move:m.id});zero.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(zero),/有 PP/);const blocked=make({move:m.id});timer(blocked,0,'skillBlock');turn(blocked);assert.equal(blocked.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(sum(blocked,'percent'),0);}

const a=make({move:10128,aStats:{spe:1}});turn(a,10128,10127);const base=make({move:10128,index:-1,aStats:{spe:1}});turn(base,10128,10127);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a)-2*sum(base))<=2);

success.assertion:
for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true,hp:1000}),c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,2024);assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.phase,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.phase,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38150?m.pp:m.pp-1);const zero=make({move:m.id});zero.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(zero),/有 PP/);const blocked=make({move:m.id});timer(blocked,0,'skillBlock');turn(blocked);assert.equal(blocked.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(sum(blocked,'percent'),0);}
 let checked=0;for(const move of source.moves){checked+=require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[move]}}).length;console.log('# 4834 base verified '+move.id);}assert.equal(checked,22);

success.name: 4834/1879双防严格较高护罩400否则200，含战阶比较，同源刷新异源独立不触消失
success.assertion: for(const [stage,want]of[[-1,200],[0,200],[1,400]]){const a=make(row(1879));a.fighters[0].stages.def=stage;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].suitState.barrier,want);turn(a,29189);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].suitState.barrier,want);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.barrierAilmentTriggers.filter(x=>!x.done).length,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].ailments['瘫痪'],undefined);}

success.name: 4834/1879来源护罩消失50%瘫痪共享随机成功失败，不因其他护罩仍在而漏触发，免异失败不重试
success.assertion: const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<30&&seen.size<2;seed++){const a=make({...row(1879),seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(a);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.refreshBarrier(c.a,300,'independent-test-barrier');if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.a.counts.immune=5;c.hurt(c.t,200,'耗尽1879新授源','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.suitState.barrier,300);const after=c.a.counts.immune;seen.add(after===4);c.hurt(c.t,100,'其他来源继续受伤','fixed');assert.equal(c.a.counts.immune,after);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.barrierAilmentTriggers[0].done,true);}},()=>turn(a,29189));}assert.equal(seen.size,2);
